## Scythe Horn (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 N Large animal  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+1 dodge, +1 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 58 (7d8+2)  
 **Fort** +8; **Ref** +6; **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** antlers +11 (2d6+6) or butt +10 (1d8+6)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** stampede, trample (2d6+6, DC 19)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 4  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 24 (28 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (antlers), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Perception +10, Swim +12  

**Special Abilities**

 **Stampede (Ex)** A stampede occurs if three or more creatures with stampede make a trample attack while remaining adjacent to each other. While stampeding, the creatures can trample foes of their size or smaller, and the trample’s save DC increases by +2.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate hills and plains  
 **Organization** solitary or herd (6–30)  
 **Treasure** none
